name: GitLab CE 19 DevOps Platform
description: Self-hosted Git, merge requests, issues and wiki. Own your code.

PORT.description: Port GitLab's bundled nginx listens on; Railway routes the public domain and its healthcheck here.

GITLAB_HOST.description: Host name in GitLab's external URL (https://...). Change it to your custom domain after adding one, then redeploy.

GITLAB_ROOT_PASSWORD.description: Password of the 'root' administrator, applied once when the database is created. Change it in GitLab afterwards.

GITLAB_RUNNER_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN.description: One-time token (create_runner scope only, 30-day expiry) that GitLab creates for root so the GitLab Runner service can register itself. The runner revokes it after use. Clear it to disable automatic runner registration.

GITLAB_PUMA_WORKERS.description: Puma web worker processes (~600-900 MB each). 0 = single process for very small instances.

GITLAB_POSTGRES_SHARED_BUFFERS.description: shared_buffers of the bundled PostgreSQL. Raise it with the service's memory.

GITLAB_PROMETHEUS_ENABLED.description: Run the bundled Prometheus, Alertmanager and exporters (about 300 MB extra).

GITLAB_KAS_ENABLED.description: Run the GitLab agent server for Kubernetes (KAS), served under /-/kubernetes-agent/ on the same domain.

SMTP_ADDRESS.description: Optional SMTP server for e-mail (notifications, password resets). Leave empty to disable e-mail. Outbound SMTP needs Railway Pro.

GITLAB_EMAIL_FROM.description: Sender address for GitLab e-mails, e.g. gitlab@{your-domain}.

GITLAB_OMNIBUS_CONFIG.description: Optional extra gitlab.rb Ruby lines, applied after the template's settings (e.g. registry or OmniAuth configuration).

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Time for 'gitlab-ctl stop' to shut down PostgreSQL and the other components cleanly on redeploy.

GITLAB_INTERNAL_URL.description: GitLab URL on the private network; used for the API, job traffic and git clones.

GITLAB_RUNNER_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN.description: Token used once to create and register an instance runner automatically, then revoked.

GITLAB_RUNNER_TOKEN.description: Optional runner authentication token (glrt-...) from Admin > CI/CD > Runners > New instance runner. Takes precedence over the bootstrap token.

GITLAB_RUNNER_CONCURRENT.description: Jobs this runner executes at the same time.

GITLAB_RUNNER_TAGS.description: Tags of the automatically created runner (comma separated).

GITLAB_RUNNER_RUN_UNTAGGED.description: Let the automatically created runner pick up jobs without tags.

GITLAB_RUNNER_DESCRIPTION.description: Description of the automatically created runner in GitLab.
